summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize no rights-dependent monetization, tracking expansion, alert expansion, or regulated/age-sensitive scope expansion. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics but not storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms point against the proposed commercial/public use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, and revenue disposition: retain the technical compliance baseline as evidence only, not certification. Current compliance is 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has permission errors and yellow freshness/coverage; failed sources must remain unknown, not zero. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable, so ROI, margin, payback, and monetization claims remain unsupported. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry. Parked or unreachable sites require an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed and 4 remain open. Progress is limited to partial API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy evidence; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Private and gated-site decision: keep SearchWoot private pending completion of the launch checklist, human counsel review, technical/security acceptance, accuracy/freshness evidence, measurement reconciliation, and owner disposition. For complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com, retain parked status; do not expose or monetize until reachability, site content, compliance, analytics, monetization, and launch checklists are evidenced. The current scaffold/parked and unreachable evidence does not support a bounded public launch.
